# signalk-plotterext-bus 0.27.0 (vendored)

The extension side of the Signal K plotter extension message bus, copied
unchanged from the npm package `signalk-plotterext-bus@0.27.0` (`dist/extension.js`
and the two chunks it imports). MIT licence, see LICENSE.

Vendored rather than an npm dependency so the plugin keeps no runtime
dependencies and the pages load with no build step. To update, copy
`dist/extension.js` and the chunks it imports from the new version.
